title: Accept exact stored metadata during scheduled continuation claims
description:
As an operator, I want a due scheduled continuation to resume exactly once, so that a retryable living-report publication can recover without manual metadata rewriting.

Observed behavior: the recovery service parses stored JSON metadata and reserializes it with different whitespace before using an exact GraphQL condition. Semantically identical metadata therefore fails the conditional claim.

Feature: Scheduled continuation metadata authority

Scenario: Compact stored JSON is claimed exactly
Given a Procedure and parent Task are waiting at the same durable scheduled-continuation checkpoint
And their stored metadata is valid compact JSON
When the inclusive resume time is reached
Then the recovery service uses the exact stored metadata value in conditional mutations
And the parent Task is rearmed exactly once

Scenario: Changed metadata still fails closed
Given the stored metadata changes after the recovery read
When recovery attempts the conditional claim
Then the mutation is rejected
And no duplicate execution is dispatched

Out of scope: GraphQL schema or resource changes; weakening checkpoint identity; launching a new portfolio run.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Board audit 2026-10-17: verified against develop. Scheduled-continuation recovery (primus/cli/procedure/resume_service.py) preserves the exact stored metadata string and claims against the exact read version, so compact JSON rearms once while changed records fail closed. Covered by test_resume_service.py exact-read-version, duplicate-claim and changed-boundary tests.
